text:
emma: Quick heads up — planning to bump to v1.12.0 later today. Need a quick pre-push check: changelog sweep, sbom/artifact pin, annotated tag, and create GH draft release. Can folks confirm owners and any blockers? :eyes:

liam: I can do the changelog sweep. ETA 30m. Any specific format we want for the changelog header?

sam: I'll handle building the artifacts and uploading checksums. Will push to the release branch and leave the artifacts in the staging bucket.

maria: Sec question — do we want the SBOM attached to the GH release or hosted separately with signed manifests? Prefer attaching a signed SBOM as an asset.

emma: @maria yes attach as asset + add signed manifest. Also: annotate tag must include the binary checksum and PR list. Keep it short.

liam: For changelog header, let's use the usual: "v1.12.0 — YYYY-MM-DD — Highlights" and then bullets. Keeps automation compatible.

sam: Command snippets for tagging / publish I plan to use:```bash
git checkout -b release/v1.12.0 origin/main
git tag -a v1.12.0 -m "v1.12.0 — release: changelog and artifacts"
gh release create v1.12.0 ./artifacts/* --title "v1.12.0" --notes-file CHANGELOG.md
```

emma: Perfect. Add `--discussion-category` if we want a draft discussion. Also ensure the tag is pushed with `git push origin v1.12.0` before `gh release create` so CI picks it up.

sam: Will include checksum file `checksums.txt` with SHA256 lines. Example: `sha256sum artifact.tar.gz > checksums.txt`

liam: Reminder: cutoff for backports is in 2 hours (2056796212). If anyone needs a last-minute cherry-pick, ping here now.

maria: I'll sign the manifest once SBOM is generated. Ping me with the SBOM artifact path in staging.

release-bot: CI: build/v1.12.0-staging passed — artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-releases/staging/v1.12.0 (sha256 verified). [details] :white_check_mark:

emma: Great. Quick owners list: changelog @liam, artifacts @sam, SBOM & signing @maria, tag + GH draft I'll coordinate and cut once you all ack. If no objections, plan to cut at 2056789400 (~7m). :shipit:

liam: Ack.

sam: Ack, will start upload now.

maria: Ack — will be on standby to sign.

emma: Cutting at 2056789400. I'll post final tag command here before pushing.

sam: FYI leaving a small note — build contains the new quantize kernels, we should call out in changelog as "inference perf improvements" so users know.

emma: Noted — liam can add a one-liner under highlights.

(1 more minute)

emma: Final tag command:```bash
GPG_TTY=$(tty) git tag -a v1.12.0 -m "v1.12.0 — release; includes inference perf improvements"
git push origin v1.12.0
gh release create v1.12.0 ./artifacts/* --notes-file CHANGELOG.md --draft
```

sam: Done uploading checksums and SBOM to staging, posted path in the release bucket.

maria: Signing SBOM now... signed and uploaded, posted signature as `sbom-v1.12.0.sig` in the same bucket.

release-bot: Release Draft created (v1.12.0) by @emma — assets attached, draft status. :tada:

emma: Thanks team — I'll ship the draft to public after the short canary tomorrow unless we see regressions. Closing this thread. :cool:
